_meta.description: Word problems for grade 3-4. Each item has a story, the operation kids should identify (+ - x /), the numbers involved, and the final answer. Story Sorter uses these directly.

items.story: Sam has 14 marbles. His friend gives him 8 more. How many does he have now?
Maya had 25 stickers. She got 17 more for her birthday. How many stickers does she have?
There were 20 cookies on the plate. The class ate 12 of them. How many cookies are left?
Jaya had 32 pencils. She gave 15 to her brother. How many pencils does she have left?
There are 6 bags. Each bag has 4 apples. How many apples in total?
A classroom has 7 rows of desks with 8 desks in each row. How many desks are there?
24 candies are shared equally among 6 kids. How many candies does each kid get?
There are 36 players in the soccer tournament. If each team has 9 players, how many teams are there?
Tia read 47 pages on Monday and 38 pages on Tuesday. How many pages did she read altogether?
The train had 84 passengers. 27 got off at the first stop. How many are still on the train?
A florist arranges 9 vases with 6 flowers in each vase. How many flowers did she use?
48 cupcakes are packed into boxes of 8. How many boxes are needed?
Marcus saved $56 in January and $47 in February. How much has he saved so far?
A toy costs $23. If Kai gives the cashier $50, how much change does he get?
There are 5 bicycles at the shop. Each bike has 2 wheels. How many wheels are there in all?
A pitcher holds 60 ounces of lemonade. If each cup holds 6 ounces, how many cups can be filled?
The library received 33 new books in the morning and 28 more in the afternoon. How many new books did they get?
There were 90 paintings on display. 34 were sold on opening night. How many are still on display?
Lila planted 8 rows of tomatoes. Each row has 12 plants. How many tomato plants did she plant?
The zoo trip lasted 6 hours. That's the same as how many 30-minute periods?
Class 3A has 24 students. Class 3B has 26 students. How many students in both classes?
There were 16 slices of pizza. The kids ate 11. How many slices are left?
Reo does 3 chores every day. How many chores does he do in one week?
40 shoes are sitting by the door. How many pairs is that?
The pond has 45 goldfish and 38 tadpoles. How many creatures live in the pond?
A book has 128 pages. Ana has read 79 pages. How many pages does she have left to read?
A carton holds 12 eggs. How many eggs are in 4 cartons?
A flag has 6 stripes for every 2 stars. If there are 24 stripes, how many stars are there?
18 kids from one class and 22 kids from another class are going on a field trip. How many kids total?
A tree had 100 leaves. 46 blew away in the storm. How many leaves are still on the tree?
